listing.descriptionMarkdown:
## About
Rokid FC is an NES (FC) emulator for Rokid AR glasses. The glasses display the game screen while a phone browser acts as a gamepad over a local network.

## Key features
- Upload and play .nes ROMs using the built-in emulator kernel
- Phone browser gamepad with directional keys, A/B, START/SELECT buttons
- Low-latency WebSocket connection for smooth, continuous input
- Instant save and load game states per ROM
- Volume control directly from the phone gamepad page
- Manage game library via web interface with upload and delete

## How it works
- Launch the app on the glasses to show the game list and server address
- Open the glasses' IP address in a phone browser to access the game library
- Upload ROMs and enter gamepad mode to control the game running on the glasses

## Controls
- Top center: volume up/down, instant save/load
- Left side: directional pad
- Right side: A (top right), B (bottom left)
- Bottom center: SELECT and START

## Notes
- Add the gamepad page to your phone's home screen for fullscreen, app-like experience
- Requires phone and glasses on the same local network
- If the phone cannot connect, check glasses WiFi status and restart if needed
